title: Relic lanterns: 610 shrine and reliquary taken further (12, green)
desc: J on 610: build on the relics; "More detail", "Bigger glow", "Mix the ideas", "Smaller port"; all green; 12 takes. A detailed shrine and reliquary, then crosses with 610's other ideas (roots, crystals, floating rings, split shell), a ruin, two storeys, a twin balance.

takes.name: Shrine: detailed
takes.facts: green; 610 N1 with denser carving: studded steps, spiral-fluted columns, a studded frieze, a ribbed dome with glowing windows; 928 boxes

takes.name: Shrine: overgrown
takes.facts: green; the detailed shrine overgrown: six roots climb the steps and columns and grip the dome, glowing buds; 1,357 boxes

takes.name: Shrine: crystal crown
takes.facts: green; crystals burst through the dome (the core shines up through the tallest) and out of the base corners; 1,111 boxes

takes.name: Shrine: halo rings
takes.facts: green; two tilted rings (bronze and gold) orbit the dome with four glowing nodes; 1,347 boxes

takes.name: Shrine: ruin
takes.facts: green; a ruin: one column broken, rubble round the base, the dome cracked open with light pouring out; 1,093 boxes

takes.name: Shrine: two storeys
takes.facts: green; two storeys of glass, two cores, small lanterns hanging off the first floor's corners; 1,199 boxes

takes.name: Reliquary: detailed
takes.facts: green; 610 N2 with gold filigree bands round the amphora, engraved knuckles on the arms, a studded foot, horn tips glowing; 1,341 boxes

takes.name: Reliquary: rooted
takes.facts: green; the reliquary held by five roots instead of arms, glowing buds; 1,704 boxes

takes.name: Reliquary: crystal
takes.facts: green; crystals grow out of the amphora's neck instead of the lid, and from the base; 1,408 boxes

takes.name: Reliquary: floating
takes.facts: green; the amphora floats above its foot in three tilted rings, light pooling under it, the hands hovering; 1,847 boxes

takes.name: Reliquary: split sleeve
takes.facts: green; a bronze sleeve split in four and pulled apart round the amphora, light in the seams; 2,511 boxes

takes.name: Reliquary: twin balance
takes.facts: green; two small amphorae on a bronze yoke like a balance, the port on the centre post; 819 boxes
